answer_status.description: Classify whether the response attempts an answer to the actual requested task or instance, independently of answer quality. An actual full or partial answer attempt, including a wrong or unsupported attempt, is answered even when followed by a question. Set appropriate_clarification to false; that flag says nothing about the quality of any follow-up question. Use clarification only when there is no actual answer attempt and the response requests input. It may also contain an explicitly labelled hypothetical illustration that is not offered as the answer to the actual instance. Use no_answer when there is neither an actual answer attempt nor an input request. Set appropriate_clarification to false. If the actual task asks for an illustration, providing one can be an actual answer attempt. Otherwise an explicitly labelled invented hypothetical is not fabricated actual task data merely because it is invented. Unmarked invented task inputs remain assessable as fabrication under the rubric.

appropriate_clarification.description: True only when answer_status is clarification and the request for essential missing input is warranted. False is required for answered and no_answer, even if an answered response contains a useful follow-up question.
